title: patient.guardian.handover_due.v1
description: A minor with a guardian on file turns 18 within 14 days and the claim invitation was requested (IDC-012, ProfileClaimJob); subject = the patient. Opaque patient references and the handover date only (the date the guardian access review starts, never the date of birth as a field). Consumers comms-gateway (the invitation itself travels as comms.notification.requested.v1): log-only handler until it exists.

patientRef.description: The young adult's opaque patient reference.

handoverDate.description: The clinic date from which the profile can be claimed.

version.description: Outbox id of this event: monotonic per aggregate.
